title: DevFlow AI
subtitle: Code Intelligence & Security Analysis Platform
overview: DevFlow AI is an AI-powered software engineering and security analysis platform designed to analyze entire code repositories, identify potential issues, and provide actionable insights to developers.
problemStatement: Engineering teams spend extensive time diagnosing repository-wide bugs, catching security vulnerabilities before deployment, and reviewing pull requests without automated contextual analysis.
proposedSolution: An automated platform combining static code analysis, AI-assisted defect and security-risk identification, and isolated execution pipelines with GitHub webhook integrations.
implementedFeatures: Repository-level code analysis
AI-assisted defect and security-risk identification
Static code analysis and dependency insights
GitHub Apps and webhook integration
Context-aware pull request reviews
Asynchronous analysis and test execution pipeline
Isolated execution environments
Dashboard for code quality and security insights
architectureNotes: React frontend communicates with Express.js and FastAPI services. Redis & BullMQ manage asynchronous repo-ingestion tasks, with Docker providing isolated analysis environments.
verificationNotice: Project Completed. Source code repository verified on GitHub (MohammedAffan-786/DevFlow-AI). Architecture and backend services verified.

title: EduReach
subtitle: Agentic College Chatbot & Guidance Assistant
overview: EduReach is an AI-powered college assistance platform designed to help students access institutional information through conversational interactions. It uses an AI agent with knowledge retrieval to answer questions about courses, fees, admissions, and placements.
problemStatement: Prospective and current college students find it challenging to navigate fragmented college websites, syllabus documents, fee structures, and placement records.
proposedSolution: An agentic AI chatbot equipped with knowledge retrieval and tool-calling to provide verified answers about courses, fees, admissions, and campus guidance.
implementedFeatures: Agentic AI chatbot with tool-calling capabilities
Knowledge retrieval using a college information base
Student assistance for courses, fees, and admissions
Placement-related information assistance
AI voice counselor integration
REST API integration
JWT-protected routes
plannedFeatures: Real-time voice dialogue streaming with Vapi
architectureNotes: React.js frontend interacts with Node.js/Python backend. Google Gemini powers knowledge retrieval against MongoDB Atlas, secured by JWT authentication.
verificationNotice: Project Completed. Source code repository verified on GitHub (MohammedAffan-786/EduReach-Agentic-College-Chatbot).

title: Research Rabbit AI
subtitle: Semantic Literature Discovery & Citation Graph Intelligence
overview: Research Rabbit AI is an intelligent semantic research and literature discovery platform designed to understand natural-language academic inquiries. It indexes research papers, maps multi-hop citation relationships into visual knowledge graphs, and synthesizes answers backed by verifiable source citations.
problemStatement: Traditional search engines rely strictly on literal keyword queries, failing to understand semantic research intent, connect interdisciplinary literature, or synthesize evidence with traceable source citations.
proposedSolution: A semantic research platform leveraging vector similarity indexing, citation relationship graphs, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to generate grounded literature reviews with verifiable citations.
implementedFeatures: Semantic search using natural-language vector queries
Web and research document indexing pipeline
Vector database integration (Qdrant & embeddings) for similarity retrieval
Interactive citation graph mapping relationships between research topics
RAG-based factual question answering with verified source citations
Interactive research collection management and paper bookmarking
architectureNotes: React frontend renders interactive citation graphs and search results. FastAPI service performs semantic query embedding against Qdrant vector database, while PostgreSQL manages paper metadata and user collections.
verificationNotice: Project Completed. Source code and architecture verified with vector search and citation graph exploration.
